title: One security finding, as passed to the workflow through --goal-file

id.description: The report-local finding id. The only report-derived value the workflow acts on.

file.description: Repository-relative path to the flagged code. Absolute paths and .. segments are rejected.

snippet.description: The flagged source line. Used to locate the code at HEAD by content.

symbol.description: The enclosing function or method, when the report recorded one.
